systems.country_label: TRE, part of the Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
systems.tiers: launched at the DEF in Praia on 29 July 2021, with capture of facial image, fingerprints, signature and height; to be extended gradually to the Polícia Nacional regional commands and to esquadras on São Nicolau, Maio and Brava

note: A SNIAC service page on the electronic residence card for foreigners; esquadras are named only as future places to apply for the card and the criminal record only as a document an applicant supplies, and nothing is stated about stations recording reports or cases.
